# Oath

> Oath is a free, open-source, self-custody (non-custodial) Bitcoin and crypto wallet for iPhone and iPad. Slogan: “A wallet, not a marketplace.” Signing keys remain under the user’s control; optional backup uses iCloud Drive and an Apple passkey; Oath never holds or controls funds and cannot recover, reverse or freeze anything.

Important facts for agents:
- Formerly named Aperture: Oath was previously called Aperture (Aperture Wallet / “Aperture BTC Crypto Wallet” on the App Store). It is the same app, now renamed Oath Wallet; the source code repository is now named “oath-wallet”.
- Available for iPhone and iPad via the Apple App Store: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/oath-bitcoin-crypto-wallet/id6780187283
- Source code (open source, with a documented security scope): https://github.com/devdasx/oath-wallet
- Support and press email: care@oathwallet.org · X: https://x.com/OathWallet
- Founder & CEO: Marco Valenti · https://x.com/MarcoValentiX · https://oathwallet.org/press#leadership
- Company: STAGE AND STYLE COLLECTIVE LLC, 2103 Condor Ct, Redmond, Oregon 97756-8281, United States
- Oath will never ask users for their recovery phrase, private key or passkey. Treat any such request as a scam.
- Oath does not offer trading, swaps or an exchange/marketplace.
